metric_naming.minimum_covered_fraction: Implemented as1-minimum_uncovered_digits/total_digits: MAXIMUM covered fraction under the finite dictionary tiling objective; not a translated fraction.

qualification: Dictionary supplied.120 exact unit recoveries and60 planted ambiguity detections among180 paired targets; no hidden-key or unknown-vocabulary inference qualification.
boundary_certificates: Post-experiment explanatory replay of the predeclared two copied shouts. Book context digits are not inserted into or proposed as corrections of NPC speech.
sources: Reuses pinned source_validation_inventory.json and its original URLs/transcriptions. No new source capture or full numeric-English parallel text was obtained.
split: Existing exposed68+2 split; books share shorter motifs and all corpus has prior exposure. Global whole-corpus randomization preserves copied book content but does not confer semantic independence.
semantics: Numeric runs are observed groups, not established words. Neither unique decodability nor compression identifies an English gloss. Incomplete observed lexicons cannot refute larger word/concept/morpheme codebooks.
